notablePrerequisites:
Triskelion has at least 2 +1/+1 counters on it.
Mirrormade is a copy of Rite of Passage.
description:
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Triskelion to deal 1 damage to Triskelion.
The Rite of Passages trigger, putting 2 +1/+1 counters on Triskelion.
Repeat for infinite +1/+1 counters.
End the turn, removing all damage marked on Triskelion.
Remove infinite counters from Triskelion to deal infinite damage.
